sections.title: 1. Introduction and Purpose
sections.body: The Information Security Management System (ISMS) of MedSecure Health Services is established to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of patient information and clinical systems supporting healthcare delivery operations.

sections.title: 2. Organizational Boundaries
sections.body: The ISMS applies to the following departments within MedSecure Health Services:

sections.title: 3. Geographic and Physical Boundaries
sections.body: The scope includes all information processing facilities located at:
bullets: Main Hospital Campus: Including secure server rooms hosting EHR systems.
Satellite Clinic Locations: Connected via encrypted MPLS links.
Remote Access for Physicians via VPN with MFA.

sections.title: 4. Technical and Logical Boundaries
sections.body: This ISMS encompasses the healthcare IT ecosystem, specifically:
bullets: Electronic Health Record (EHR) Systems hosted on Windows Server infrastructure.
Active Directory and Azure AD for identity management.
Endpoint Management via Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
Network segmentation protecting clinical systems and medical devices.

sections.title: 5. Exclusions and Justifications
sections.body: The following areas are excluded from the scope:
bullets: Medical devices not connected to the corporate network.
Third-party insurance clearinghouses operating under separate compliance programs.

sections.title: 6. Stakeholders and External Dependencies
sections.body: The scope accounts for the security requirements of:
bullets: Regulatory compliance with HIPAA and state healthcare regulations.
Cloud hosting provider Microsoft Azure for backup and disaster recovery.
